mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining >1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite PAYEMS rising >1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in a tightening cycle (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2% AND unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by over 0.1 percentage points in three months, the combination signals accommodative monetary policy and labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite FEDFUNDS <2% and UNRATE rising >0.1pp (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the INDPRO index (supply expansion) indicates improved business conditions, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite INDPRO rising >1% over 3 months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the INDPRO index (supply expansion) and sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3% indicate improved business conditions and lower discount rates, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite INDPRO rising and FEDFUNDS falling (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5% signals labor market stress, prompting corporate cost-cutting and reduced investment, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals further accommodative policy, reducing risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS falls >1% over 60 days (p > 0.05).
